headline: Global hunger falls from 35 percent in 1970 to 7.8 percent
meta_description: Fifty years of progress: world hunger rates have plummeted from over one-third to under 8 percent of the global population.
summary_short: In a stunning reversal, global hunger has dropped from affecting 35 percent of people in 1970 to just 7.8 percent today.
body:
In a stunning reversal, global hunger has dropped from affecting 35 percent of people in 1970 to just 7.8 percent today. This represents one of humanity's most significant achievements in fighting poverty and food insecurity.

The decline spans five decades of progress—from 1970 to the present—marking a fundamental shift in how the world feeds itself. While 7.8 percent still represents millions facing hunger, the trajectory shows what sustained effort and development can accomplish. Fewer people go without adequate food now than at any point in the modern era.
quick_facts: Global hunger fell from 35 percent in 1970
Current hunger rate stands at 7.8 percent
Progress spans five decades of improvement
